map.给定均值、标准差和上下界，计算正态分布下的区间概率。: Computes interval probabilities under a normal distribution given the mean, standard deviation and lower and upper bounds.
map.📖 查看「正态分布概率使用指南」: 📖 View the "Normal Distribution Probability User Guide"
map.P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = [Φ((b−μ)/σ) − Φ((a−μ)/σ)]: P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = [Φ((b−μ)/σ) − Φ((a−μ)/σ)] × 100%, where Φ is the standard normal cumulative distribution function
map.把区间上下界 b、a 分别标准化为 (b−μ)/σ 与 (a−μ)/σ，再取标准: The bounds b and a are standardized to (b−μ)/σ and (a−μ)/σ and the difference of their standard normal cumulative probabilities gives the area under the normal curve over [a, b] (multiplied by 100 for a percentage). Entering a very large negative lower bound such as −1e9 approximates negative infinity and yields P(X ≤ b). The probability outside the interval is 1 minus this value.
map.下界可填很大的负数近似 -∞。: Use a very large negative lower bound to approximate -∞.

map.产品质量\"落在规格内\"比例。: The share of product quality measurements falling inside specification.
map.μ=0,σ=1 为标准正态。: μ=0, σ=1 gives the standard normal.
map.μ=0、σ=1、a=−1、b=1：Φ(1)−Φ(−1)=0.8413−0.158: μ=0, σ=1, a=−1, b=1: Φ(1)−Φ(−1)=0.8413−0.1587=0.6826, i.e. 68.3% of the observations lie inside the interval.
map.μ=100、σ=5、规格[90,110]：z1=−2、z2=2；P≈Φ(2)−Φ: μ=100, σ=5 and specification [90,110]: z1=−2, z2=2; P≈Φ(2)−Φ(−2)=0.9545, so about 95.5% conform.
map.正态下分别含 68.3%/95.4%/99.7%（经验法则），快速估\"正常波动: Under normality they cover 68.3%, 95.4% and 99.7% respectively (the empirical rule), a quick way to gauge the normal range of variation.
map.非正态能套用？: Can it be applied to non-normal data?
map.不能，区间比例会偏离经验值；需按实际分布或用 Chebyshev 不等式（至少: No. The proportions then depart from the empirical values, so use the actual distribution or Chebyshev's inequality (at least 1−1/k²).
